verdict.rationale: The only evidence of recurring scheduled work is a third-party Zapier example, "Monthly Export of Brex Card Transactions to CSV in Google Drive". Workato and Pipedream integrations are also documented for automating Brex operations, so recurring jobs depend on external automation tools rather than a native scheduler. Brex's AI agents and approval routing are event-driven policy automation, not user-defined scheduled workflows. Missing for 10: native scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows, first-party docs on configuring schedules or cron-like triggers, an AI/MCP-driven way to set up recurring tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
